$schema_draft: SteelX drill-in process map v0.1 (UI Phase, locked 2026-10-07)
purpose: Data-driven flat-vector process schematic per plant, opened by tapping a placed node. Renderer draws symbols + edges + labels; tap symbol -> info card pops. Phase 2 later attaches live parameters + editable controls to symbols.

fields.id: snake_case unique id, matches the node id in nodes_phase1.json (e.g. drp, eaf, lf, cc, bar_mill, wire_rod_mill, smp_overview)
fields.title: display title of the map
fields.symbols: array of {id, label, symbol, x, y, card_id}. x/y are normalized canvas coords 0..1 (renderer scales to panel size). symbol = glyph key resolved to content/assets/symbols/<map_id>_<symbol>.png; missing file -> renderer falls back to a flat vector glyph. card_id optional: tap symbol pops that card (must resolve in cards_phase1_draft.json).
fields.edges: array of {from, to, label, kind}. from/to are symbol ids. kind: gas|solid|liquid|electric — color language: gas teal, solid material keeps the material color (ore red, scrap grey, product grey, hot zone orange), electric grey. label = stream name shown on the edge (e.g. 'Reducing gas').
fields.style: flat vector grammar (Yasser reference, Midrex diagram): slate-blue background, white symbols/pipes, white annotation labels, orange = hot-zone accent. Colors must match the grid colors the player already learned.
fields.sme_pending: true until Yasser calibrates the process topology/labels

entry_point: tap placed node -> opens its map (confirmed 2026-10-07); maps for non-listed plants are simple maps later
naming: symbol art files: content/assets/symbols/<map_id>_<symbol>.png; grid tiles: content/assets/icons/<node_id>.png (matches node ids exactly)
